verdict.rationale: Relay is an online business banking platform (accounts, cards, bill pay, invoicing). It is not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers and uses their tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
